notes.title: Poker update
notes.notes:
Changes:
1. Simplified the first puzzle. If you cannot pass it, then continue playing anyway.
2. Added the ability to play poker at any time (menu bonuses)
3. It is now possible to watch the records of other players directly while playing poker
4. Minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Survival poker!
notes.notes: You can play survival poker anytime! Just go to the bonuses in the game menu
